meta.access_policy: ATTENTION: AGENTS MUST ONLY READ OR OPERATE THIS TEMPLATE THROUGH THE xc-orchestration-author SKILL AND ITS PUBLIC COMMANDS. DO NOT OPEN, SUMMARIZE, EDIT, PATCH, OR REFORMAT THIS FILE DIRECTLY.

node.title: Prepare run
node.instructions: Read the project bridge, create the run through xc-create-run, validate requested feature IDs without creating features, and record the requested scope.
node.deliverables: An authoritative run directory and explicit feature associations.
node.acceptance: The run is independent, feature associations are explicit, and no unmanaged feature directory was created.

node.title: Approve run solution
node.instructions: Present the selected change solution, baseline impact, implementation strategy, verification strategy, and unresolved decisions. Record approval or add revision nodes.
node.deliverables: An approval decision or explicit revision work.
node.acceptance: Implementation cannot proceed on a material unresolved solution decision.

node.title: Finalize ordinary run
node.instructions: Confirm the run result, declared artifacts, feature baseline synchronization, code provenance, and residual risks, then close the run.
node.deliverables: A completed, failed, or blocked run with durable evidence.
node.acceptance: The runtime tree and context documents accurately describe the run outcome.
